LHV Group is acquiring its own shares based on the resolution of the company’s

params.linkText: general meeting of shareholders held on 26 March 2025
conditions decided by the Supervisory Board

children: . The authorized agent for the transactions is AS LHV Pank. Summary data of the acquisitions will be disclosed no later than on the seventh trading day after the transaction and will be made available to the Financial Supervision and Resolution Authority, via the Nasdaq Tallinn system, and on LHV Group’s investor website.

LHV Group is the largest domestic financial group and capital provider in Estonia. LHV Group's key subsidiaries are LHV Bank AS, AS LHV Varahaldus, AS LHV Kindlustus and LHV Bank Limited. The Group employs approximately 1,200 people. The services of LHV Bank in Estonia are used by 520,000 customers, the II pillar pension funds managed by LHV have 104,000 active customers and LHV Kindlustus protects a total of 252,000 customers. LHV Bank in the United Kingdom holds a banking licence and provides banking services to international financial technology companies, loans to small and medium-sized enterprises, and retail banking services.
Head of Investor Relations and Corporate Development
